Live pending output is capped at 1 MiB and drained at up to 64 KiB per frame with a 50 ms minimum flush interval (about 20 fps sustained). - Visibility accounting schedules the backlog flush again when the terminal becomes visible. - The terminal-host PTY path also pauses host output delivery for hidden terminals. Output racing before pause takes effect is queued client-side; output missed while paused is resynchronized by the host on resume as a delta when possible or a snapshot otherwise. - Therefore the visible burst on tab activation is a catch-up from memory/host retained output, normally spread across several frames rather than literally one single render call. - Normally the intermediate output does not disappear.
